title: Ronaldo Made $300 Million in One Year
description:
How much does the world's highest-paid athlete earn every minute?

Sources:
- Forbes: The World's 10 Highest-Paid Athletes 2026 (Forbes Australia): https://www.forbes.com.au/news/sport/the-worlds-10-highest-paid-athletes-2026/

Forbes estimate for May 1, 2025 to May 1, 2026, before taxes and agent fees. Per day = $300M / 365; per minute = per day / 1,440. Not financial advice.

#shorts #ronaldo #soccer #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you kick a ball around, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: How much does the world's highest-paid athlete earn every minute?
Forbes says Cristiano Ronaldo earned about 300 million dollars in the year to May 2026.
About 235 million came from playing soccer. 65 million came from sponsors and other deals.
That's about 822 thousand dollars a day.
Or about 571 dollars every minute, even while he's asleep.
It ties the biggest athlete payday Forbes has measured since 1990.
